class_config.name: data_converter
class_config.description: ORGANIC #613 — data converter / mixed-signal IC with a digital serial readout: an analog→digital (or digital→analog) conversion core (sigma-delta / SAR / pipeline ADC, or DAC) that emits/consumes a digital serial bitstream. Has analog content AND a digital decimation / serial-readout datapath, but no SW-visible command protocol and no control FSM, so it must NOT collapse to pure_analog (which SKIPs RTL entirely). The analog track (A1..A8) sizes the converter; spec-to-rtl authors the digital decimation / serial-readout datapath; the digital backend (synth → PnR → GDS) implements it.
